BRANDING §5.3 leaves this open.

All-Geist is coherent, fast and safe. A display face gives the brand somewhere to have a
personality, which for a nightlife product is not a small thing — but it costs a font load on the
critical path and a decision about fallbacks.

Worth settling **as part of** the visual design pass rather than separately, since the answer
depends on what that pass wants the site to feel like.
